releaseNotes: V985 fixes Device Scene/HMI vertical workspace clipping on 1440p-class displays by giving the existing scene surface a 1600-DIP minimum vertical extent inside a native WPF ScrollViewer.

Mouse-wheel vertical navigation and an automatic vertical scrollbar now expose scene items below the visible viewport; horizontal sizing remains viewport-owned so the existing responsive X-position behavior is unchanged.

This is a presentation-only maintenance patch. Device Scene source mapping, read-only HMI authority, selection/marquee behavior, Runtime, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Signal Tower control, and V984 deterministic AI/Grounding paths are unchanged.

en: Device Scene/HMI no longer clips lower scene content on 1440p-class displays; the scene now has a scrollable 1600-DIP minimum vertical workspace.
The native vertical scrollbar and mouse wheel move through lower scene content while horizontal responsive sizing remains unchanged.
Presentation-only maintenance fix; Runtime, communication, HMI read-only authority, Signal Tower control, and V984 AI/Grounding behavior are unchanged.
ko: 1440p급 화면에서 Device Scene/HMI 하단 콘텐츠가 잘리던 문제를 수정했습니다. Scene은 1600 DIP 최소 세로 작업영역을 가지며 스크롤할 수 있습니다.
세로 스크롤바와 마우스 휠로 하단 Scene 콘텐츠를 이동할 수 있고 기존 가로 반응형 배치는 그대로 유지됩니다.
Presentation 전용 유지보수 패치이며 Runtime, 통신, HMI Read-Only 권한, Signal Tower 제어, V984 AI/Grounding 동작은 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: 1440p クラスの画面で Device Scene/HMI 下部が切れる問題を修正し、1600 DIP の最小縦ワークスペースをスクロール可能にしました。
縦スクロールバーとマウスホイールで下部の Scene を確認でき、既存の横方向レスポンシブ動作は維持されます。
Presentation のみの保守パッチで、Runtime、通信、HMI Read-Only 権限、Signal Tower 制御、V984 AI/Grounding は変更していません。
zh-CN: 修复了 1440p 级显示器上 Device Scene/HMI 底部内容被裁切的问题，Scene 现在具有可滚动的 1600 DIP 最小垂直工作区。
可通过垂直滚动条和鼠标滚轮查看下方 Scene 内容，同时保持原有横向响应式布局不变。
仅为 Presentation 层维护补丁；Runtime、通信、HMI Read-Only 权限、Signal Tower 控制以及 V984 AI/Grounding 均未修改。
de: Das Abschneiden unterer Inhalte in Device Scene/HMI auf 1440p-Displays wurde behoben; die Scene besitzt nun einen scrollbareren vertikalen Mindestarbeitsbereich von 1600 DIP.
Vertikale Scrollbar und Mausrad ermöglichen den Zugriff auf tiefere Scene-Inhalte, während das bestehende responsive horizontale Layout unverändert bleibt.
Reiner Presentation-Wartungspatch; Runtime, Kommunikation, HMI-Read-Only-Autorität, Signal-Tower-Steuerung und V984 AI/Grounding bleiben unverändert.
es: Se corrigió el recorte del contenido inferior de Device Scene/HMI en pantallas 1440p; la escena ahora dispone de un área vertical mínima desplazable de 1600 DIP.
La barra vertical y la rueda del ratón permiten acceder al contenido inferior manteniendo intacto el comportamiento horizontal adaptable existente.
Parche de mantenimiento solo de Presentation; Runtime, comunicación, autoridad HMI Read-Only, control de Signal Tower y V984 AI/Grounding permanecen sin cambios.
